params.texture_prompt: Preserve the existing fictional Starfare Kestrel concept: broad compact navy delta passenger hull with a split rear notch, two integrated angular aft shrouds, one long glazed central lounge, fine fitted hull panels, brushed pale alloy perimeter and dark graphite recesses. Narrow cyan painted trim; restrained warm cabin windows. Physically based navy ceramic paint, satin alloy and smoked glazing; micro roughness and normal detail. No stars, titles, logos, planet, platform or background baked into textures. No propulsion glow, exhaust, navigation flashing, invented flight motion or character features.

required_input.description: ONE isolated three-quarter hero view from the existing Kestrel concept; preserve silhouette and panel language, remove sheet title, the two lower orthographic views, stars and background; neutral white background. Do not submit the full multi-view concept sheet.

versions.art: independent Kestrel Higgsfield feasibility trial; no generated model yet
versions.target_main_source: coordination message; verify against GitHub before integration
versions.design: PR12 7839868 + standalone presentation changes; not the merged game

materials: no source background or typography baked
glazing inspected without assuming transparent mesh exists
geometry: triangle count and disconnected parts measured
no unwanted ground slab or extra ships
transform: unit-length display normalization only; no invented physical ship size
size: GLB bytes and texture dimensions measured
acceptance.motion: static asset preview; manual rotation only, no flight or burn animation
